Step 1.1 now constructs k=(p+iq)u_3, e=E_*u_1, h=(p+iq)E_*u_2/(mu*omega), verifies all four amplitude conditions and uses pthm-em-medium-plane-wave-fields(b) to supply a smooth ideal solution, bounded on x_3>0. Confirmed F2 called tangent the principal inverse, but def-principal-inverse-tangent defines tan:(-pi/2,pi/2)->R as the bijection and arctan:R->(-pi/2,pi/2) as its inverse. This is nonfatal because the proof uses the correct tangent ratio/Pythagorean identities and A1’s unique angle, not an inverse with the erroneous domain. Repaired F2 and separated F1’s medium formulas from its oblique-interface wavevector conventions. Direct calculation gives sin(theta_B)=3/sqrt(13), cos(theta_B)=2/sqrt(13), equal p-admittances, r_s=-5/13, t_s=8/13 and R_s+T_s=1; the propagating-angle and nonzero-denominator hypotheses hold.
